page.overview:
Who is Amazoness Tiger?

Amazoness Tiger is a character version of the card, "Amazoness Tiger".

Amazoness Tiger appears in the video game, Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008. He appear as a Tag Duel opponent and his Tag partner is Amazoness Chain Master. Their team name is Barbaric Pride.

In World Championship 2008, Amazoness Tiger uses a Amazoness Deck titled, "Rough and Ready".
